summary: 已完成非平衡统计物理领域输入：阅读两篇综述全文和一篇经典论文的APS摘要记录，提炼三种可迁移的路径/涨落结构及三个未解决张力。未提出跨领域idea，也未运行实验。

artifacts.observation: 记录了3种形式结构、适用假设、3项开放张力和来源。
记录检索日期、逐篇阅读范围、可支持的内容及APS全文访问限制。

evidence.detail: 全文将宏观状态写为密度和电流场，受连续性方程约束；对联合时空涨落赋予作用量，并讨论时间反演、非局域准势、长程关联及动力学相变。
全文从随机轨迹定义功、热和熵产生；在基本Markov情形下要求局部详细平衡，并统一讨论积分/详细涨落定理以及记忆与粗粒化。
APS可访问摘要报告：作者推导剪切稳态应力反向涨落的有限时间概率关系，并称模拟支持该关系。所读页面未提供全文。
上述文献结构适合把问题表述为路径反演不对称、守恒约束下的稀有历史代价，或路径集合的统计相变；这些是领域结构的概括，不是新颖性主张。

claims: 领域严格名称为 Non-equilibrium statistical physics。
给出的结构均为已知统计物理形式，不主张其本身新颖。
路径概率比的标准熵产生解释依赖明确的正反过程与系统边界；标准Markov推导还依赖局部详细平衡。
宏观涨落理论结构依赖所选粗粒化、连续性约束、构成关系和极限过程。
limitations: Evans等人的APS访问页面只显示摘要与元数据，未能阅读全文。
MFT卡片侧重驱动扩散/水动力学框架；多守恒量、非Markov和非扩散情况未作系统综述。
开放张力是根据所读文献限定的领域问题，不代表全面文献综述结论。
next_actions: 后续idea builder可把这些结构与其他领域卡片并置，生成交叉学科候选；本领域卡片本身不替代交叉创新判断。

structures.name: Irreversibility as a ratio of path probabilities
structures.relation: Compare a forward trajectory with its time-reversed counterpart. Their probability asymmetry encodes entropy production and yields fluctuation relations, shifting attention from averages to the relative weights of histories.
assumptions: Forward and reverse ensembles and the time-reversal map are explicitly defined.
The standard stochastic-thermodynamic derivation assumes Markov dynamics with local detailed balance and explicit accounting of relevant reservoirs and variables.

sources.title: Stochastic thermodynamics, fluctuation theorems, and molecular machines
sources.content_note: Read the full review, including trajectory-level thermodynamic definitions, fluctuation theorems, and the section on memory and coarse-graining.

sources.title: Probability of second law violations in shearing steady states
sources.content_note: Read APS abstract and metadata: reports a finite-time probability relation for stress-sign-reversing fluctuations in a sheared steady state, with simulation support; full text was closed on the accessed page.

structures.name: Conservation-constrained action over histories
structures.relation: Represent time-dependent density and current fields, constrain them by a continuity equation, and assign each admissible space-time history a fluctuation cost. Rare-event questions become constrained minimum-cost-history questions.
assumptions: A hydrodynamic or coarse-grained description and its constitutive current are specified.
Standard macroscopic fluctuation theory relies on driven diffusive scaling and specified transport coefficients; the elementary presentation begins with a single conserved quantity.

sources.title: Macroscopic fluctuation theory
sources.content_note: Read full review sections on hydrodynamics, the fundamental space-time path formula, and density/current large deviations; histories obey the continuity equation and have an action cost.

structures.name: Dynamical phases from large-deviation singularities
structures.relation: Nonanalytic changes in a scaled cumulant-generating function or rate function can signal a change in the dominant class of histories even when ordinary averages vary smoothly.
assumptions: A suitable long-time or large-system limit exists and the chosen observable has a well-defined large-deviation function.
Interpreting a singularity as a phase transition requires specifying the limit and boundary conditions.

sources.title: Macroscopic fluctuation theory
sources.content_note: Read the large-deviation and current-thermodynamics sections; the review discusses singularities interpreted as non-equilibrium dynamical phase transitions.

open_tensions: How should entropy production and fluctuation relations be formulated when coarse-graining hides slow variables, memory, or dissipative channels? Different microscopic dynamics may induce the same observed trajectories but different time-reversal asymmetries.

When do non-equilibrium stationary states require a nonlocal quasipotential, and how are nonlocality and long-range correlations related to boundary driving, conservation laws, and competing optimal histories?

Which fluctuation symmetries and path-space phase transitions persist beyond Markov dynamics, local detailed balance, and diffusive hydrodynamic scaling, especially with multiple coupled conserved quantities?
